hook: What if the Iguazú River surged six times its normal flow?

sections.voiceover: What if the Iguazú River surged six times its normal flow?
In October 2026, Super El Niño flooded the region, pushing the Iguazú River sixfold. How wide is the falls stretch across Argentina and Brazil?
The Iguazú River surged past the one-mile span of the falls, flooding Argentina and Brazil.
Iguazú Falls spans just over one mile across the Argentina‑Brazil border. Consequently, Iguazú National Park closed temporarily, stopping all visitors.
Six times the flow, one mile of falls, Iguazú National Park closed temporarily in October 2026.
